sentences.en: Your essay was not bad but I have a few minor niggles.
sentences.zh: 你的论文不错，但我有几个小问题。

sentences.en: I'm fed up with your constant niggling, Mary.
sentences.zh: 玛丽不停地找茬让我很烦，Mary。

sentences.en: Mary would always niggle Tom over his lack of punctuation in text messages.
sentences.zh: 玛丽总是因为汤姆短信中的标点符号不全而挑毛病。

senses.zh: 拘泥小节；为琐事费时；挑剔
